photo.001:
📷 Photo import

Kis cheez ki photo bhejni hai? Neeche se chunein.

Photo bhejne ke baad bot pehle dikhayega, aap YES likhein tab save hoga. Kuch bhi save hone se pehle aap dekh sakte hain.
photo.002:
👥 Customers ki list ki photo

Tips:
1. Poori list ek photo mein frame ho
2. Roshni achhi ho, kaghaz seedha ho, dhundla na ho
3. Naam aur phone number saaf parhe jaa sakein
4. Ek page = ek photo

Ab photo bhejein. Bot list dikhayega; YES likhne tak kuch save nahi hoga.
photo.003:
📦 Products ki price list ki photo

Tips:
1. Naam aur price saaf dikhein
2. Cost bhi likha ho to woh bhi dikhayein
3. Ek page = ek photo

Ab photo bhejein. Bot list dikhayega; YES likhne tak kuch save nahi hoga.
photo.004:
👷 Tankhwah ki list ki photo

Tips:
1. Naam aur raqam saaf dikhein
2. Ek page = ek photo

Ab photo bhejein. Bot list dikhayega; YES likhne tak kuch save nahi hoga.
photo.005: 🧾 Order ki screenshot bhejein. Bot draft dikhayega; Save dabane ya likhne tak kuch save nahi hota.
photo.006: ⚠️ Tasveer se padhi gayi cheezein galat ho sakti hain, khaas kar likhai, naam, phone aur price. YES likhne se pehle list zaroor check karein.
